name: multilingual POPE benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate hallucination generation in large vision-language models across multiple languages, focusing on reducing hallucinations in both high-resource and low-resource languages.
reputation: A multilingual extension of the well-known POPE hallucination benchmark, with growing relevance for cross-lingual VLM evaluation.
notes: Focuses on mitigating hallucination in multilingual vision-language models using a two-stage framework and cross-lingual alignment.
